Three top-level leaf obligations, fresh UUID ids, path-safe camelCase names doubling as DOM field names: export const responsiblePersonName = { id: '<uuid>', name: 'responsiblePersonName', status: 'mandatory' }; export const responsiblePersonEmail = { id: '<uuid>', name: 'responsiblePersonEmail', status: 'optional' }; export const responsiblePersonTelephone = { id: '<uuid>', name: 'responsiblePersonTelephone', status: 'optional' }. DECISION (recorded, see notes): email/telephone are OPTIONAL at model level because the legacy rule is 'at least one of email/telephone' — the joint-OR is a controller fieldset rule per house D-13 parity (the planningBrief's own instruction 'email-OR-telephone rule is a controller fieldset rule, NOT model'); marking both model-mandatory would make a legal email-only save leave the row permanently incomplete. NO copy, no display logic, no gate helpers (obligation-purity enforces). Exemplar shape: sets/live-animals/obligations/sections/misc.js.

Import-free page identity: export const contactDetailsPage = { id: 'contact-details', slug: 'contact-details' }.

export const meta = { ...contactDetailsPage, collects: ['responsiblePersonName', 'responsiblePersonEmail', 'responsiblePersonTelephone'] }. GET: state.get() ONCE, prefill the three inputs from answers (entry page in pass 1 — POP-2 auto-population deferred to pp-048, so no server-populated values). One render() helper for GET + POST errors: kit.base(copy.title, { backLink: hubPath(journey.journeyId), journey }), copy, errors, kit.errorSummary(errors). POST: read raw request.payload; validate with lib/validate factories in Joi voice, one canonical string per rule (c-018): responsiblePersonName required 'Enter your name', max 32 'Name must be 32 characters or fewer'; responsiblePersonEmail optional, format via pattern() with a pragmatic email regex 'Enter an email address in the correct format, like name@example.com', max 255 'Email address must be 255 characters or fewer'; responsiblePersonTelephone optional, format via pattern(/^\+?[\d\s]+$/) (the legacy acceptance — digits/spaces, optional leading +) 'Enter a mobile number in the correct format, like 07700 900 982 or +44 7700 900 982', max 30 'Mobile number must be 30 characters or fewer' (c-020: 'Mobile number', fixing the legacy 'Telephone number' error-copy inconsistency). FIELDSET RULE (house D-13 parity, pp-028 pairing precedent): after field validation, if BOTH email and telephone are empty add error 'Enter an email address or mobile number' keyed on responsiblePersonEmail (error-summary link focuses the email input, the first field of the pair). Invalid → 400 re-render RAW values; valid → state.commit() cleaned values (trim; commit only non-empty of email/telephone — never commit an empty-string answer) wrapped in kit.recoverableSave() (marked failure → recoverableError:true, 500; other errors throw); redirect await kit.nextTarget(request, page, committed.scope). routes = kit.pageRoutes(page, { get, post }). Do NOT port: the legacy Agent free-text field, the etag hidden field, entry-point hidden fields/query decoration, or the four-way legacy button routing — house kit/hub/change-context semantics replace them (review-change return is pp-038's Change machinery).

notes: 1:1 carry of inc-023 (MAPPING verbatim). Opens the contacts section (spoke 7, §2.1): new sections/contacts.js, contact flow section, contact task row, hub GROUPS entry. Follows add-a-section in its one-page degenerate form (pp-028 precedent). Exemplars pinned this session: sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/contact/ (single-page feature shape — controller/render/copyFor/recoverableSave/pageRoutes idiom, verified live; note it is a radios page, so take the STRUCTURE not the field handling), cph-number (text-input validation idiom per add-a-field), transport (section + task row + hub GROUPS wiring), origin e2e spec (per-rule validation + axe pattern). Decisions taken headless, all grounded in the page spec + plan: (1) MODEL STATUS — §3.1's shorthand 'responsiblePersonName/Email/Telephone (mandatory)' is resolved as name mandatory, email/telephone OPTIONAL in the model with the joint at-least-one rule as a controller fieldset rule; this is the only reading consistent with the same sentence's 'email-OR-telephone is a controller fieldset rule, NOT model (house D-13 parity)' and with legacy semantics (each individually optional; class-level joint annotation) — both-model-mandatory would strand the row Incomplete on a legal email-only save. (2) AGENT FIELD DROPPED — the legacy CHED-PP-only free-text 'Agent' input is not built: the page spec's own analysis marks it a prime deletion candidate (only ever echoes itself, never displayed anywhere, never exercised, optional at both layers), §3.1's contacts row omits it for the responsible person, and the backend responsiblePerson.isAgent stays unsent with a mapper omission assertion (obligation-field-map lists isAgent as the schema home; nominatedContacts' contactIsAgent is pp-033's separate concern). (3) VALIDATION COPY — frontend 'Enter …' voice wins over the backend 'Add …' variants (c-018 single-layer Joi voice; backend is draft-nullable per D-13 so its strings never render); the legacy 'Telephone number must be 30 characters or fewer' becomes 'Mobile number …' per c-020 (one term for the field across label + errors). (4) TELEPHONE ACCEPTANCE — keep the legacy regex /^\+?[\d\s]+$/ via the pattern() factory rather than a stricter ukPhone rule (the legacy field accepts landline-shaped values; DoA fixture '0123456789' must stay valid). (5) INTRO COPY kept verbatim from the spec (both sentences) but rendered as govuk-body paragraphs, not the legacy multi-paragraph div.govuk-hint (the spec's nonStandardPatterns entry recommends exactly this); sentence 1 presumes pre-population — flagged in openQuestions since pass 1 is an entry page. (6) LEGACY MACHINERY NOT PORTED — no etag hidden field (records port is whole-document last-write-wins, §6.2 Open Q 3 ruling), no entry-point hidden fields/decorateUrl, no four-way button routing: house save-actions + kit.nextTarget/hubExit/change-context semantics replace them; review-change re-entry is owned by pp-038's Change machinery. (7) CHECK-ANSWERS ROWS deferred to pp-038 (which reads back every captured area), matching the pp-028 precedent — recipe step 5 deliberately not done here. (8) POP-2 auto-population (responsible person derived from the owning-org member) is DEFERRED with pp-048; this page is plain entry in pass 1, so no system-populated policy entry and no records-derived prefill beyond normal answer prefill. (9) OR-error anchor: keyed on responsiblePersonEmail so the summary link lands on the first field of the pair (GDS error-summary focus contract). Sequencing: dependsOn pp-007+pp-009 verbatim from MAPPING; the contract.plant-products.test.js edit and hub/task-row wiring assume the m0 scaffolding family (pp-010) and hub skeleton (pp-007) landed, which milestone order guarantees. Not platform-touching (all edits inside sets/plant-products + the plant-only contract table), so the two-sided sibling-safety check is not mandatory — npm test in the ladder still exercises the parameterised copy-convention/copy-parity suites over both sets.
